up: Retrieve standard_type, standard_value, standard_units, canonical_smiles, and compound chembl_id for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614031. Only include exact activity values (standard_relation = '='). Join activities with assays on assay_id, and join with compound_structures to get canonical_smiles. Return exactly these columns.
sql: SELECT a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614031' AND a.standard_relation = '='
